TabFM source wheel

Source: https://github.com/google-research/tabfm

Package version: 1.0.1
Pretrained model version evaluated: TabFM v1.0.0, regression

This wheel was built without source modifications from the pinned official repository.
Model weights are not included. Their separate non-commercial, non-production license
is available in the official Hugging Face repository:
https://huggingface.co/google/tabfm-1.0.0-pytorch
